bullets.text: Ofcom Fines Virgin Media £23.8m - Ofcom penalises **Virgin Media** for risking vulnerable customers during digital landline migration.
Openreach Closes First Exchange - **Openreach** decommissions its first PSTN exchange, marking a shift to digital full fibre.
Telecoms Must Embrace Agentic AI - The industry must adopt **agentic AI** to enhance efficiency and customer satisfaction.
Wi-Fi 8 Focuses on Reliability - **Wi-Fi 8** prioritises intelligence and reliability over speed, adapting to AI-driven applications.
Nokia's Strange Week - **Nokia** faces scrutiny over job cuts in Europe while investing heavily in the US.
Telco Groups Challenge AI Models - An industry challenge seeks to develop **AI** models for diagnosing network faults.
Vodafone Germany Challenges Cartel Office - **Vodafone** contests investigation into alleged anti-competitive behaviour towards **1&1**.
Samsung and SK Telecom Partner on AI-RAN - The duo aims to enhance **6G** infrastructure with AI-driven radio access technology.
World Communication Awards 2025 Shortlist - The **World Communication Awards** recognises leading innovators in the telecom industry.
Proximus and Starlink Expand Satellite Connectivity - **Proximus Global** partners with **Starlink** to enhance direct-to-cell satellite services in Europe.
